notes.title: Our Heartwarming New Title《Reviver》launches on January 9th!
notes.content:
Greetings, everyone!

Mark your calendars! Reviver, our latest creation, launches on Steam January 9th! 
Prepare to be swept away by a narrative puzzle game weaving together romance, time travel, and destiny.ːDaisySHOCKː

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2239130

Reviver represents a departure for CottonGame, delving deeper into storytelling and offering richer, more extensive text than our previous titles. 
Experience a poignant love story that spans a lifetime, from youthful exuberance to the golden years.ːDaisyGJː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840735/db25d6651fd574b60f5501f48c11ee1ebd0f648f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840735/2f05e8c683fa9dfbddb7cd2729e94e86d27c3ec6.jpg[/img]

True to its name, Reviver embraces the butterfly effect as its core mechanic. 
Your choices, made across different eras, ripple through time, dramatically altering the narrative's course. 
Avert disastrous outcomes with seemingly small decisions, rewriting fate itself!ːtobdogː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840735/dbd843e213fee95b6db599b520b3780a2b66a57a.png[/img]

ːsteammockingːNaturally, we've retained the signature CottonGame brain-teasing puzzles you've come to expect. 
To complement this, we've sprinkled in a variety of engaging minigames, offering delightful diversions throughout your journey.

Intrigued? Wishlist Reviver now to be notified the moment it releases!ːSpeech_Loveː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840735/c91cbeaecc20dc24d9b40b2b26cde418be6edb24.png[/img]
Stay tuned – more exciting news is on the horizon!

Warmly,ːSpeech_Loveː
CottonGame

notes.title: Small Update - Fixed a series of bugs 1.15
notes.content:
Thank you all for your support for The Lost Island 4: Cabin Experiment! Thanks to the feedback from players, we discovered several hidden bugs in the game during the first week and promptly made adjustments and fixes.

Fixed the following bugs on certain devices during gameplay:
1.Fix Android 14 device crash issues
2.In some cases, the item bar image size was incorrect.
3.Some devices experienced a black screen and were unable to run the game.
4.Bugs related to the battery item at the beginning.
5.Some items were missing after the game is closed.
6.Rapid clicking the astronaut resulted in obtaining multiple white fruits.
7.A few errors in the text.
8.Few animation playback errors.

Hope you enjoy this familiar yet unfamiliar, mysterious and unpredictable journey.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796978/c009108d09c608b0622305b07cb20368fca89260.png[/img]

notes.title: 《迷失岛系列》新作《迷失岛4小屋实验》现已正式发售
notes.content:
The fifth game of the"ISOLAND Series," titled "ISOLAND 4: The Anchor of Memory," is now officially released. Enjoy a special 10% discount during the first week, with a sale price of 16.2 RMB. Puzzle game enthusiasts shouldn't miss out!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796978/6d5468e3ac055798ecb0e7e35d0de880a9c908b0.jpg[/img]

Embark on a journey to this mysterious island, waking up in unfamiliar rooms. Unravel fascinating puzzles through interactions with scenes, items, and characters, ultimately revealing the secrets of the cabin experiment. But is everything you see the truth? Have you deciphered every dialogue? It's all for you to experience within the game.

Lastly, as an indie game series approaching its 10th year, the success of the "ISOLAND Series" reaching its fifth installment is truly thanks to your continuous support and love. We sincerely appreciate everyone's contributions. We genuinely hope you continue to enjoy the series. As long as you still love it, we'll keep creating for this series!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796978/036c6bce0deb06091dd8ad0fdd19a704ade4e91d.jpg[/img]
